Your exploratory data analysis of the team datasets go here.


Dataset: https://github.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/blob/main/data/2024/2024-05-14/readme.md

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(fs)
coffee_survey <- readr::read_csv('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rfordatascience/tidytuesday/main/data/2024/2024-05-14/coffee_survey.csv')

head(coffee_survey)
```
```{r}
#making a smaller subset from the coffee data
coffee_small <- coffee_survey |>
  select(submission_id, age, favorite, additions, where_drink, wfh)

head(coffee_small)
dim(coffee_small)

# Check the answer choices
coffee_small |> count(favorite, sort = TRUE)
coffee_small |> count(additions, sort = TRUE)
coffee_small |> count(where_drink, sort = TRUE)
```

## What types of coffee do people drink (ex: black, latte)?
```{r}
coffee_small |>
  filter(!is.na(favorite)) |>
  count(favorite) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = fct_reorder(favorite, n), fill = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(guide = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Number of respondents", y = "Favorite coffee drink",
       title = "Most Popular Coffee Drinks")
```


## What trends of coffee additives are there? (ex: sweet, cream, cold foam etc)
```{r}
additions_summary <- coffee_small |>
  filter(!is.na(additions)) |>
  summarize(
    `Nothing (black)`  = mean(str_detect(additions, "black")),
    `Milk or creamer`  = mean(str_detect(additions, "Milk")),
    `Sugar/sweetener`  = mean(str_detect(additions, "Sugar")),
    `Flavor syrup`     = mean(str_detect(additions, "syrup")),
    `Other`            = mean(str_detect(additions, "Other"))
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "addition", values_to = "prop")

additions_summary |>
  ggplot(aes(x = prop, y = fct_reorder(addition, prop), fill = addition)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(guide = "none") +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Percent of respondents", y = "Addition",
       title = "What People Add to Their Coffee")
```


## building off of Emma's question of where they drink their coffee
## Where are they drinking their coffee and how does it related to where they work? (ex: home, office)
```{r}
coffee_small |>
  filter(!is.na(where_drink), !is.na(wfh)) |>
  separate_longer_delim(where_drink, delim = ", ") |>
  group_by(wfh) |>
  mutate(n_people = n_distinct(submission_id)) |>
  group_by(wfh, where_drink) |>
  summarize(prop = n() / first(n_people), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = prop, y = fct_reorder(where_drink, prop), fill = wfh)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(end = 0.8) +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(x = "Percent of respondents", y = "Where they drink coffee",
       fill = "Work arrangement",
       title = "Where People Drink Coffee")
```
